text: 周四（8月27日）欧市尾盘，德国10年期国债收益率涨1.6个基点，报3.251%，日内交投于3.221%-3.255%区间，欧市早盘持续走高、北京时间17:00以来高位窄幅震荡——持稳于3.250%附近。 两年期德债收益率涨1.9个基点，报2.861%，日内交投于2.828%-2.883%区间；30年期德债收益率涨1.6个基点，报3.754%。 2/10年期德债收益率利差跌0.287个基点，报+38.754个基点。 法国10年期国债收益率涨1.3个基点，报4.102%；两年期法债收益率涨1.6个基点，30年期法债收益率涨1.5个基点。 意大利10年期国债
text_en: In late European trading on Thursday (August 27), the yield on Germany's 10-year Bund rose 1.6 basis points to 3.251%, trading within a 3.221%-3.255% range during the day, climbing steadily in early European trade and holding a narrow range at highs since 17:00 Beijing time, steady near 3.250%. The 2-year German yield rose 1.9 basis points to 2.861%, trading within a 2.828%-2.883% range; the 30-year German yield rose 1.6 basis points to 3.754%. The 2/10-year German yield spread fell 0.287 basis points to +38.754 basis points.
